title: Add error logging to transcription chunk pipeline
description: Replace silent try? with do/catch + logging in WhisperTranscriptionService.transcribe(systemURL:micURL:). Log HTTP status, x-request-id, and error body per chunk. Make parseWhisperResponse throw on unexpected JSON. Include collected errors in thrown WhisperError.

title: Import audio file into plain note
description:
Add drag-and-drop + file picker to NoteEditorView so users can attach phone recordings.

Flow: drop/pick audio file -> copy to app storage (ImportedAudio/) -> Whisper transcribe -> GPT speaker inference -> summarize -> attach MeetingAttachment to existing note in-place.

Key: fix WhisperTranscriptionService content-type to detect file extension (m4a/mp3/wav) instead of hardcoding audio/wav. Pause autosave while importing. Keep existing note body/tags/title. Switch to MeetingDetailView on success via selectedNote refresh.

title: AI chat with full meeting control
description: Extend meeting chat so AI can take actions: retranscribe audio, regenerate summary, rename speakers, add/remove tags. Also add recovery UX for failed meetings.
close_reason: Implemented: chatWithMeetingControl, MeetingActionExecutor, updated MeetingChatView with recovery UX. Build passes.

title: AssemblyAI speaker diarization for system audio
description:
Replace WhisperTranscriptionService system-audio path with AssemblyAI Universal-3 Pro + Speaker Diarization add-on ($0.23/hr total, cheaper than Whisper alone at $0.36/hr).

System audio (remote participants) gets sent to AssemblyAI for acoustic diarization -> speakers tagged 2..N.
Mic track (local) stays as Whisper Speaker 1.
Merge by timestamp, same as current dual-track path.

New service: Services/AssemblyAIService.swift
New settings fields: assemblyAIApiKey in AppState + SettingsView.
Fallback to Whisper-only if AssemblyAI key missing or call fails.
Codex scoping done: /tmp/codex-diarization.md

title: Fix audio clipping regression
description: writeSampleBuffer in AudioRecorder.swift converts Float32->Int16 without peak normalization (removed when switching from mixing to per-stream writes). Re-add peak normalization: peak = max(abs(samples)), gain = min(0.9/peak, 4.0), clamp to [-1,1] before Int16 conversion. Sonnet fix already applied — needs Codex review + commit.

title: AI chat with full meeting control
description:
Extend MeetingDetailView chat to support AI-triggered actions via structured JSON output.

Actions: retranscribe (re-run Whisper), regenerate_summary (with optional user context), rename_speaker, add_tag, remove_tag.

New OpenAIService method: chatWithMeetingControl() -> ChatOrActionResult (mode: answer|action, assistantMessage, action: {type, args}).
New MeetingActionExecutor service validates and executes mutations.
Recovery UX: when segments.isEmpty && audioFilePath != nil, show chat chips 'Retranscribe this meeting'.
Separate isRunningAction state for long ops. Failure appended as chat message, not silent print.
Capture note ID before async actions to avoid stale overwrites.
